title: [feat]/ Recover safely from audio-device loss and backend restarts
body:
<!-- omatainer-professional-backlog: sys-audio-device-recovery -->
**Priority:** P0 · **Area:** audio · **Tracking:** #1

A live set must survive USB removal, interface failure and audio-server restart without losing its document.

**Evidence and scope**

- Audited baseline: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L365 and https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/Cargo.toml. This capability is absent or materially narrower in the current command model, UI and dependency graph.
- Professional-readiness requirement inferred from the combined producer/live-DJ brief; not asserted to be a bundled feature of either reference product.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Detect lost devices and expose clear recovery state without crashing.
- [ ] Reconnect by stable identity, preserving routes and preventing accidental output on a different device.
- [ ] Offer explicit safe fallback and resume behavior with controlled ramps.
- [ ] Run unplug/replug, server restart and suspend/resume fault tests while recording and performing.

**Validation**

Exercise the workflow through the shipped UI, persist/reopen applicable state, and test cancellation and failure paths. Record the actual supported platform and fixture results.

**Dependencies**

- #94 — [feat]/ Configure professional audio devices, sample rates and buffers
- #82 — [feat]/ Save and reopen complete native production and DJ projects

**Evidence and scope**

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Introduce asynchronous seekable decode with bounded read-ahead and waveform/analysis caches.
- [ ] Handle scratched/reverse/looped playback without synchronous file IO in the callback.

<!-- omatainer-professional-backlog: dj-automatic-variable-grids -->
**Priority:** P2 · **Area:** library · **Tracking:** #1

Stable manual tempo anchors are a separate feature; Serato 5.0 public beta adds the newer automatic Lucid Beatgrids benchmark. Omatainer currently estimates one BPM.

**Evidence and scope**

- https://the-drop.serato.com/announcements/introducing-lucid-beatgrids-in-serato-dj-5-0/
- https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/dsp.rs#L543

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Analyze variable beat times with confidence and a choice of fixed/flexible grid policy
- [ ] Preview changes and preserve locked/manual anchors unless explicitly replaced
- [ ] Version analysis results so algorithm updates can be compared or reverted

**Validation**

Evaluate a labeled live-drum/tempo-ramp corpus with documented beat/downbeat accuracy; beta benchmark is not claimed stable.

**Dependencies**

- #134 — [feat]/ Support manually mapped tempo changes within a track
- #104 — [feat]/ Add persistent background track analysis with selective reanalysis

Baseline: Omatainer `cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7`; professional-capability review dated 2026-09-30. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.

body:
<!-- omatainer-professional-backlog: dj-midi-clock-input -->
**Priority:** P1 · **Area:** midi · **Tracking:** #1

The parser fix alone does not estimate tempo/phase, select a master or handle external transport. This is a hybrid-performance requirement, not a claim that Serato offers arbitrary clock input.

**Evidence and scope**

- https://midi.org/midi-1-0-core-specifications

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Follow a selected clock source using timestamps and stable tempo/phase estimation
- [ ] Handle start, continue, stop and supported song-position messages coherently
- [ ] Expose loss/jitter status and a chosen freewheel/stop policy without oscillating tempo

**Validation**

title: [feat]/ Provide playable physics-inspired modulation and generative sound devices
body:
<!-- omatainer-professional-backlog: prod-nature-generators -->
**Priority:** P3 · **Area:** production · **Tracking:** #1

The project has no generative particle/physical-process control sources; Suite-included Inspired by Nature represents this distinct creative category.

**Evidence and scope**

- https://www.ableton.com/en/packs/inspired-nature/
- https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L42-L50
- https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/ui.rs#L223-L253

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Provide original gravity/orbit/collision or growth-inspired generators with visible deterministic state.
- [ ] Map generated events to MIDI, modulation and applicable sample/granular parameters.
- [ ] Expose seed, reset, rate and bounded-complexity controls so projects replay safely.
- [ ] Ship original examples and explain that benchmark Pack assets/patches are not redistributed.

**Validation**

Create a deterministic evolving composition using two independent generators, render repeatedly and confirm repeatability and bounded processing.

**Dependencies**

- #338 — [feat]/ Provide evolving step, probability and polyrhythmic sequencer devices
- #343 — [feat]/ Add assignable LFO, envelope, shaper and performance-expression modulators
- #311 — [feat]/ Provide a sample-based granular synthesis instrument

Baseline: Omatainer `cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7`; professional-capability review dated 2026-09-30. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.

title: [feat]/ Integrate optional licensed sample-provider search and audition for production
body:
<!-- omatainer-professional-backlog: prod-sample-provider -->
**Priority:** P3 · **Area:** production · **Tracking:** #1

Live12.3 includes Splice integration, but external catalogs and subscriptions are not free factory assets; Omatainer has no provider abstraction.

**Evidence and scope**

- https://help.ableton.com/hc/en-us/articles/22060471916316-Splice-integration-in-Ableton-Live-FAQ
- https://www.ableton.com/en/manual/working-with-the-browser/
- https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L42-L50
- https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/ui.rs#L223-L253

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Provide a provider-neutral search, preview, license/acquire and import workflow with explicit account/cost state.
- [ ] Support similarity or audio-query search only where a provider officially exposes and permits it.
- [ ] Download acquired assets into managed project media with receipts/provenance and offline fallback.
- [ ] Keep the provider optional and use authorized APIs; do not scrape protected catalogs or imply subscription content is bundled.

**Validation**

Using an authorized test account, preview and license a sample, import it into a project and verify offline reopening and entitlement errors.

**Dependencies**

- #317 — [feat]/ Browse, tag and audition instruments, presets, clips and production samples
- #347 — [feat]/ Find and swap acoustically similar production samples
- #116 — [feat]/ Collect project media and package portable self-contained sessions

Baseline: Omatainer `cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7`; professional-capability review dated 2026-09-30. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.
